description.narrative: To create an enabling environment for action by civil society (CSOs and their Networks representing fishing communities, with a focus on women and youth leaders) in economic governance, through inclusive and creative platforms, and engagement in political dialogue with key decision makers and economic actors at local and national levels

title.narrative: SO.2. CFis network actively engaged and taking their issues to national and international dialogues/forums.

description.narrative: The number of CFis network who demonstrate proactive involvement and active participation in national and international discussions, meetings, and platforms, where they raise awareness among stakeholders about the challenges, concerns, and priorities of community fisheries on a broader scale, while implement various advocacy initiatives, sharing valuable experiences and knowledge, influencing policy decisions, and fostering collaboration with diverse stakeholders in area of fisheries management, coastal resource conservation, livelihood improvement, and social justice.
